title: fix(spec)!: the view write door refuses an unknown top-level key
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB5z61o2LpDkGEiu41Hnhi5p)_

Fixes #26711

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the `view` write door refuses a body carrying an undeclared top-level key on a view item record or an inline list or form view, which it saved before without the key. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed (a saved `view` body may no longer carry a top-level key its shape does not declare)
Skills-docs: none — no page under skills/** or content/docs teaches that the view write door kept an unknown top-level key; the authoring surfaces (defineView / defineViewItem) were already closed

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`view` 写入口(`ViewMetadataSchema` 的 view item 记录、内联 list 覆盖、内联 form 覆盖三个成员)从 `.strip()` 改为封闭,未知顶层键返回 422 `unrecognized_keys` 并点名;container 本来就是封闭的。
- 为什么改:自 #20051 起保存的是解析后的 body,未知键(拼错的、已退役的如 `striped`)会得到 200 但被静默丢弃,与 object / page / dashboard 写入口不一致。
- 风险与回滚:收窄型变更,带 `unrecognized_keys` 的旧请求现在会被拒;已测语料(示例 59 个 view、showcase 启动后 36 个已服务 view 的回写)零误伤;唯一受影响的平台写入方是 UI 适配器 `createView` 给 envelope 加顶层 `data`,本 PR 已修。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`(`closeWireMember` 与三个成员),再看 `view-wire-unknown-key-refusal.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local src/ui/view-wire-unknown-key-refusal.test.ts`,以及 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的:进入队列前需要一次 contract 级评审(收窄型协议变更)。

## What changes

`ViewMetadataSchema` judges every `view` body saved through `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/:name` (draft or publish), the MCP metadata tools and Studio. It is a union of four members. The `defineView` container was already closed; the other three stripped their top level:

- the view item record `{ name, object, viewKind, config }` (`ViewItemWireSchema`'s arms),
- the inline list view overlay (`ListViewOverlayWireSchema`),
- the inline form view overlay (`FormViewOverlayWireSchema`).

Since the save stores the parsed body (#20051), a key one of them did not declare answered `200` and was not stored. All three are now closed with the same `strictObject` / `closedObject` machinery the other doors use, so the save answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with an `unrecognized_keys` issue that names the key and the shape: ``Unrecognized key(s) on this inline list view: `striped`.``

- **Console decorations are kept.** The preprocess still removes the console's row ids on `filter[]` / `sort[]` before the check; the save door removes the read decorations (`_diagnostics`, `_draft`) and the server-stamped provenance (`_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_provenance`) before it validates, as it did before. Every key the console writes and reads back (`VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS`: `isDefault`, `isPinned`, `sortOrder`, `visibility`, `columnState`, `_isOverride`) is declared on the member it is written on.
- **Retired keys get what their retirement gives them.** Keys with a live 18.x tombstone (`filterableFields`, `pageName`, `tabs`, `owner`, `hidden`) raise their own prescription, lifted to the union message as before. `striped`, `bordered` and `virtualScroll` retired in 17.x, and their kits have aged out under the ADR-0087 amendment of 2026-10-26 (#25767 ruling D2 = A), so they are named and pointed at the protocol upgrade guide, which is the channel that amendment prescribes. I did not re-add tombstones for them, since that would contradict the ruling.
- **Alias spellings point at the declared key.** `objectName` gets ``Did you mean `objectName` → `object`?`` and a top-level `id` gets `name`.
- **One platform writer fixed.** `ObjectStackAdapter.createView` (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`) added a top-level `data` to every spec. On a ViewItem envelope `data` belongs inside `config`, so that create would now be refused. It now adds `data` only to a flat list view (patch changeset for `@object-ui/data-objectstack` under the root `.changeset`, which is the only changeset directory the release reads). The console's own create flow goes through `createRuntimeMetadata` / `viewEnvelope` and was not affected.
- **Reverse pins moved.** `STILL_STRIP` in `metadata-type-schemas.test.ts` is now empty: `view` was its last entry, and its "end state" note is kept as history with the premise that changed. The authoring lint's view-divergence pin now asserts the registry schema refuses the key, instead of the old strip finding. The strictness ledger row for `view.zod.ts` is updated and its counts regenerated.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view-wire-unknown-key-refusal.test.ts` (new, 17 tests) covers each closed member:
  - a clean body saves;
  - console row ids are still removed;
  - a junk key is refused by name with the member's surface;
  - the container is still closed;
  - `striped` gets the upgrade-guide sentence;
  - `filterableFields` gets its live tombstone prescription;
  - `objectName` and `id` get their alias guidance.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts` exercises the real `saveMetaItem` path:
  - a draft or publish save with a junk key, or with `striped`, on an inline list view answers 422 `INVALID_METADATA` and writes 0 rows, and the message names the key;
  - the same holds for a junk key on a view item record;
  - control: a clean draft stores one row;
  - read path: a stored row carrying a junk key is served with `_diagnostics.valid: false` naming the key.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/createView.envelopeData-26711.test.ts`: `createView` on an envelope sends no top-level `data` and the platform schema accepts the body. The control shows that body with the old `data` is refused, and a flat list view still gets its default `data`.
- Re-judged fixtures that froze the strip. Each one now pins the refusal, or moves the key to where it is declared:
  - `view-authoring-wire-split`, `view-filter-rule-wire-id`, `view-metadata-schema`, `view-overlay-viewkind-arm`, `view-strictness-batch18`, `view-union-diagnostics`, `view.test`;
  - `metadata-type-schemas`, `metadata-authoring-lint`;
  - `protocol.graft-folded-form-sections`;
  - CI round at `a3aeacbf`: `@objectstack/objectql` `protocol-meta` and `protocol-publish-rollback` (`objectName` is now refused naming `object`, and `extra` is gone from the diff fixture); spec `scripts/strictness-ledger.test` (the `view.zod.ts` strip count 4 → 2, with a history line); and `view-list-filterable-fields-retirement` (an EXCLUDED entry for this PR's own refusal pin).

## Acceptance notes

- **The #5599 premise changed.** #5599 kept the members' `.strip()` only while the save stored the original body. After #20051 the save stores the parsed body, and #20456 declared the console's round-trip keys, so stripping no longer kept anything; it only lost it silently.
- **Legacy stored rows.** A row stored before #20051 that still carries an undeclared top-level key is served badged `_diagnostics.valid: false`, naming the key. This is pinned on the read side. Its next console save is refused, naming the key. That part is inferred from the same parse and was not driven through the console.
- **Corpus measured, nothing refused.** At `ef7067fd`, the example apps' view barrels (app-crm, app-showcase, app-todo, authored and expanded items) gave 59 bodies. All 59 save before and after the change. With a top-level junk key added, 49 saved before and 0 save after. `platform-objects` ships no view definitions.

## Verification

- Premise re-measured on `main` `ef7067fd` (the QA ran at `3fcafcd3`). At schema level, the list overlay, the view item record and the form overlay each accepted a junk key and `striped`, and stripped them. The container refused.
- Live showcase boot on this branch:
  - `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qa_rk_view?mode=draft` with a clean body: `200`.
  - The same body with `zzz_junk_key` or `striped`: `422 INVALID_METADATA`, and the issue names the key.
  - The stored draft keeps only the clean keys.
  - Round-trip of 36 served views (GET, then PUT back unchanged as a draft): 36 accepted, 0 refused.
- CI round at `a3aeacbf` (Test Core 1/8 and 7/8 on `66637aea` were this PR's): before the main merge, a locked wide run passed 17 of 17 suites (spec `--project repo`, objectql, rest, runtime, metadata-fs, metadata-core, cli unit, hono-server, client, audit, mcp, i18n, automation, http-conformance, security, cloud-connection, client-react). On the merged tree (`5b87033b`), `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` passed 270 files / 21672 tests, `@objectstack/objectql` passed 475 / 8843, and spec `check:generated` exits 0.
- Locked test runs on this branch, after the fixture re-judging (logs below):
  - spec, metadata-protocol, lint and metadata;
  - the 19 `ui` test files that reference the view schema exports;
  - spec and metadata-protocol typecheck;
  - `check:test-typecheck`, `check:generated` and `check:strictness-ledger`.
- Derived gates: all 89 accounted for, 0 not measured. Dogfood on the final (merged) head: 314 files, 2609 tests green.

```
                                                                   Test Files 314 passed | 3 skipped (317) · Tests 2609 passed | 20 skipped

```

Pre-merge head (same diff), also locked: spec and metadata-protocol typecheck exit 0, `@objectstack/lint` test exit 0, `@objectstack/metadata` test exit 0, `pnpm lint` exit 0.

Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 89 commands, each run with its exit code recorded):

```
Run reconciliation — 89 derived, 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 89 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 89 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).
```

Six of the 89 first answered exit 3 (prerequisite not met): five spec gates that read `dist` (the test-file edits had moved the source hash) and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needs an unshallow clone). They were re-run after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` and `git fetch --unshallow`, and all exit 0.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the `维护者速读` block is the maintainer digest the dispatch asks for).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
